That feels right. When I typed an incomplete address, it didn't quietly save something half-baked or make up the missing part on my behalf — it kept the pop-up open, didn't create anything, and told me in plain words that it needs a full address starting with http:// or https://. That's the honest way to handle it. I'd much rather be asked to fix it than have the app guess and silently turn my link into something I didn't type, because then I might end up with a bookmark pointing somewhere I never intended.

So yes, your assumption matches me: nudge me to correct it, don't guess. This is good.
